Stake history sysvar init, read, and epoch-boundary update functions.

# Purpose
This header declares the interface for the stake history sysvar in the runtime. It defines `FD_SYSVAR_STAKE_HISTORY_CAP` as the maximum number of stake history entries and documents that the sysvar stores cluster-wide activation and deactivation history per epoch. The file also declares functions to initialize the sysvar account with [`fd_sysvar_stake_history_init`](<#fd_sysvar_stake_history_init>), read it from `funk` with [`fd_sysvar_stake_history_read`](<#fd_sysvar_stake_history_read>), and update it at an epoch boundary with [`fd_sysvar_stake_history_update`](<#fd_sysvar_stake_history_update>). The included types and database headers provide the bank, account database, transaction, and stake history data types used by these functions.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_sysvar_stake_history_init`
- `fd_sysvar_stake_history_read`
- `fd_sysvar_stake_history_update`
